name: NeverLight
detailed_description:
ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST

Be first to know when the Beta or Early Access hunt begins. Get notified about launch, sales, and major updates as we journey deeper into the endless night.


About the Game

BECOME THE HUNTER THE DARKNESS FEARS

NeverLight is a cooperative roguelike extraction RPG where you and up to 3 friends become elite monster hunters in a world consumed by eternal night. Track corrupted beasts, complete challenging objectives, and escape with valuable loot before the darkness claims you.

Master deadly classes. Build your stronghold. Hunt legendary creatures. Escape as legends.

✨ KEY FEATURES

  • 1-4 player cooperative extraction with seamless drop-in/out support

  • Missions with procedural Points of Interest and Scenario generation

  • Spreading darkness mechanics create urgency and strategic decisions

  • Multiple character classes with unique abilities and playstyles

  • Persistent camp building with meaningful facility upgrades

  • Rich crafting system to forge powerful gear and equipment

  • Adaptive difficulty scaling based on team composition and progression

  • Self-hosted dedicated servers with modding support - create your own server with custom settings and mods

💀 HUNT OR BE HUNTED

The Plague of Shadows has corrupted creatures into nightmarish monsters that stalk the cursed lands. But the real threat? The darkness itself spreads across the map, consuming everything in its path and driving beasts into deadly frenzies.

Team up with friends in handcrafted hunting grounds where treasure vaults, secret missions, and valuable Points of Interest appear randomly across each expedition. Outrun the spreading shadows to complete your objectives and reach extraction points before the corruption devours everything.

Smart difficulty scaling adjusts monster strength and spawns based on your team size and gear, keeping every hunt perfectly challenging and rewarding.

⚡ GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY HUNT

Choose from multiple hunter classes, each with unique abilities and gear. Your progress persists between expeditions - every level gained and ability unlocked makes you deadlier for the next hunt.

Return to your customizable base camp between expeditions to forge new gear, choose missions, and expand your facilities. Construct buildings that unlock powerful crafting recipes, new mission types, and tactical advantages.

🛠️ MODDING & COMMUNITY

Expand your hunting experience with full modding support. Our APIs let the community create custom character classes, abilities, Points of Interest, creatures, and mission types. Shape NeverLight with your own creations and discover endless content from fellow hunters.

🎮 JOIN THE HUNT

Add NeverLight to your wishlist and be the first to know when the hunting grounds open. Follow our development updates and join the growing community of hunters preparing for the eternal night.

The night is eternal. The hunt is legendary. Your story begins now.

short_description: Cooperative roguelike extraction RPG for 1-4 players. Track corrupted beasts through dynamic missions, master multiple classes, and race against spreading darkness to extract legendary loot. Build your camp between runs and craft new gear. Full modding support included.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 2500x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 (3GB), Intel® Arc™ A380, or ATI Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
